name: Aphrodite's Day Off
source:
Hermes is punished with handling Aphordite's love affairs.
Listen to her followers well, and pocket some offerings for yourself.
But whatever you do, do not summon her.

[From [url=https://reaprieve.itch.io/aphrodites-day-off]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
赫耳墨斯因处理阿佛洛狄忒的情事而受到惩罚。
好好聆听她的追随者的意见，并为自己装一些供品。
但无论你做什么，都不要召唤她。

[来自[url=https://reaprieve.itch.io/aphrodites-day-off]itch.io[/url]]
